postings.title: Account Executive, Defence & Intelligence, France
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Based in France, the France Account Executive will be responsible for growing Planets Government sales pipeline and book of business in the Ministère des Armées and the Armées Françaises. The ideal candidate for this position is a driven, independent thinker, who can also be creative in finding new and dynamic ways to expand Planet’s government business. This person will have a proven track record of selling in government and defense, with an extensive network and able to navigate procurement processes and frameworks. They will identify, qualify, negotiate, and close large and medium-size deals and drive sales revenue targets. Most likely, the ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Military Operations and Intelligence as well as designing, forming and selling complex solutions to government customers.

This role involves developing an extensive pipeline of new sales leads, providing product and sales demonstrations to prospective customers, and formulating appropriate business. To support this, the France D&I Account Executive should have the ability to forecast accurately when managing the incoming pipeline of opportunities. The need to source, sell, co-sell, and close deals means that the ideal candidate should be familiar with the concepts of solution selling, carrying quota and closing. Above all else, we want our potential Government Sales Executive to enjoy our unique value proposition and join us in Planet’s mission to see change and change the world.

This is a full-time, remote position based in France. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Work to develop the sales pipeline needed to achieve or exceed your sales targets and goals

- Work in close collaboration with the Global D&I Sales team and Leadership

- Work with Planet’s marketing team to run campaigns to attract and identify new opportunities

- Prospect and develop business relationships, close sales, and manage customer expectations as the company grows

- Collaborate with the wider Commercial team (for example Customer Success) to foster and grow customer relationships

- Engage qualified prospects and take them through the journey of identifying a fit for Planet solutions and negotiating through agreement/contract/procurement obstacles to achieve an ultimate win

- Manage the contracting and Government procurement process

- Work closely with Solution Engineering staff to design a solution that answers customer needs and work in a cohesive manner to achieve technical validation that underpins a successful sale

- Work closely with our post sales organization and customer success team to ensure a successful onboarding for new customers

- Work strategically to develop the adequate sales pipeline needed to achieve or exceed your sales targets and goals

- Maintain an extensive level of pipeline hygiene using Salesforce.com

- Collaborate and innovate as needed to create customer-facing presentations and proposals unique to the prospect and situation

What You Bring:

- Bachelor’s Degree or commensurate professional experience

- 6+ years of related experience in software solutions and SaaS required along with a track record of success

- 6+ years’ experience selling to government customers including understanding the nuances of Government sales cycles and how to navigate through the process

- Success finding and winning business with Government customers; in particular the Ministère des Armées and the Armées Françaises

- Deep understanding of military operations and planning and the role of intelligence supporting military Commanders that could include Planet’s services.

- Excellent relationships across Ministère des Armées and the Armées Françaises and Agencies and the partner ecosystem

- Ability to satisfy French Nationality and other requirements to hold a Security Clearance

- Excellent communication skills and fluent/native French speaker

- Self-starter, able to work independently under tight deadlines in start-up environment

- Excellent judgment and decision-making skills

- Negotiation and persuasion skills

- Critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills

- Experience with Salesforce.com or a similar CRM System

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Ability to speak other languages

- Existing Security Clearance at suitable level for engaging all levels of Command

- Active Armed Forces Reserve or veteran as a relevant intelligence professional

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

- Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off

- Employee Wellness Program

- Home Office Reimbursement

- Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement

- Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning

- Equity

- Volunteering Paid Time Off

Compensation:

The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, and/or equity.

In addition to the salary range listed below, this role is also eligible to receive commission.

#LI-REMOTE

France Salary Range

€60.700—€75.850 EUR

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Why we care so much about Belonging.
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply! At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description. We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts. We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As we scale, we’re looking for a high-impact, analytical, and strategic problem-solver to join our Rev Ops team as our Sales Strategy Analyst..

You'll bring analytical rigor and strategic thinking to solve high-priority business challenges, optimize revenue performance, and help shape our go-to-market strategy.

We are looking for an Analyst of Sales Strategy & GTM Planning to serve as the engine behind our annual planning, sales capacity modeling, and strategic revenue initiatives. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Sales Strategy & GTM Ops, you will bridge strategic GTM decisions with analytical and system execution.

You will own complex quantitative models—from territory design and quota allocation to account scoring algorithms—and translate them into scalable GTM architecture. While day-to-day tactical sales execution is managed by our Sales Ops team, your focus will be on the strategic framework that enables our global field teams to succeed.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco or Arlington, VA office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Fiscal Year Planning & Modeling: Partner on annual capacity modeling, quota deployment, and territory carve-outs. Build scenario models analyzing rep ramp times, productivity curves, and coverage rules.

- Planning Stack Architecture (Pigment): Own and evolve our multi-dimensional planning models (in Pigment) to ensure automated, real-time tracking of quotas, territories, and headcount allocation.

- Account Scoring & Segmentation: Design, test, and maintain data-driven account scoring models and tiering frameworks to optimize field team focus and lead-to-account mapping.

- Data Governance & Metric Definitions: Establish metric layers and data governance standards across GTM platforms to ensure data integrity across CRM, EPM, and executive reporting.

- Recommend strategies to enhance CRM data quality and governance (e.g., opportunity hygiene, stage definitions, activity capture, account/contact integrity), and work with field teams to improve data capture processes.

- Strategic Ad-Hoc Analytics: Deliver rigorous business cases, scenario analyses, and data insights for strategic leadership initiatives across GTM leadership.

What You Bring:

- Experience: 6–8 years of relevant work experience in GTM Strategy, RevOps, BizOps, or Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) at a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology enterprise.

- Advanced Modeling Skills: Expert proficiency in multi-dimensional data modeling, scenario planning, and complex financial/operational logic in Excel/Google Sheets.

- Dimensional Planning Systems: Direct experience (or strong operational foundation) in EPM platforms such as Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive, or Workday Planning. (Pigment certification or experience is a strong plus, but willingness to master Pigment is required).

- Data & CRM Literacy: Solid understanding of Salesforce architecture, data schema, and data governance standards. SQL experience is a major plus.

- Business Acumen: Deep understanding of SaaS business metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC, Ramped Capacity, Win Rates).

- Communication: Ability to distill complex analytical findings into clear strategic recommendations for GTM leaders.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Prior experience implementing or managing models inside Pigment.

- Proven track record of owning annual quota and territory rollouts end-to-end.

- Background combining corporate strategy/consulting with hands-on systems administration.

- Solid FP&A background or Rev Ops background.

postings.offices: Berlin Office; Haarlem Office; London Office
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As a Customer Success Manager, Civil Government, you will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with a diverse range of public sector entities in CEE & Central Asia. This includes national/central governments, regional authorities, local municipalities, and key supranational organizations (e.g., Space agencies, Union bodies, and UN programmes).

You will help customers maximize the value of Planet’s imagery and geospatial solutions, ensuring that they can effectively integrate Planet data into their workflows for critical applications such as environmental monitoring, emergency response, land management, maritime surveillance, and sustainable development.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with government entities, have a solid ability to navigate highly complex and varied government structures and decision-making processes, procurement cycles, and the ability to integrate relationships across different countries and cultures. The ability to identify and build connections between ministries, directorates, and stakeholders will be key to driving adoption and impact across government initiatives.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our London, Berlin, or Haarlem office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Take full accountability for gross and net retention metrics across your book of business, ensuring long-term customer health and growth.

- Partner closely with Account Executives to build unified strategies by bringing actionable account insights and forward-looking recommendations to internal syncs.

- Map out long-term account trajectories proactively to identify capacity gaps, risks, and expansion opportunities early.

- Co-create success plans and QBRs that enable customers to clearly measure and present the business impact and ROI of Planet solutions.

- Build strong relationships across complex stakeholder networks, equipping internal champions with the data they need to advocate for the partnership.

- Lead cross-functional internal teams through critical account milestones to ensure alignment and clear execution.

- Navigate high-stakes customer situations with composure and sound judgment, prioritizing effectively under pressure.

What You Bring:

- 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management or a similar customer facing role, ideally supporting government organizations as a customer.

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

- Good working knowledge of remote sensing, GIS, or geospatial imagery products, with the ability to bridge technical workflows with commercial value.

- Experience working closely with sales organizations and a firm grasp of commercial business models. Able to act as a true consultative partner who can navigate trade-offs and ensure customer requests align with strategic and financial goals.

- Ability to read the room, pick up on what a customer is not saying, and adjust your tone, depth, and brevity depending on whether you are speaking with a technical lead or an executive.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Russian and English to support customers across Central Asia (e.g., Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan) as well as Central and Eastern Europe.

- Willingness to travel to connect with customers and internal teams.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Proficiency in using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Customer Success (CS) tools (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk) to manage workflows and report on team metrics.

- Ability to translate customer data into actionable insights.

- Knowledge of additional regional languages across Central and Eastern Europe.

- Experience leading organizational change management efforts.

- Experience with Public Procurement and Tender Processes.

- Deliver consistent project updates to customers and internal stakeholders on progress, adjustments and strategy

- Continuously improve ways of working and processes by monitoring business workflows and identifying inefficiencies

- Manage contracts with subcontractors, including task assignment, deliverable tracking, and budget management

- Measure project performance and customer satisfaction to improve future delivery

- 6+ years of experience in project management experience, including experience supporting proposal development for government or defense-sector customers

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field

- Experience preparing and contributing to technical proposals

- Experience working with or as part of the Defense and Intelligence community

- Ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects in a technical or product development setting

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to independently manage competing priorities and adapt quickly in dynamic environments

- A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to balance day-to-day responsibilities with forward-looking improvements

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience developing proposals for federal customers

- Understanding of platform development, platform integrations, or geospatial data-as-a-service offerings

- Experience with remote sensing, EO data, or imaging technologies

- Ability to be proactive in initiating efforts to improve existing programs or develop new initiatives

- Excellent organization, prioritization, and time management skills

- Experience working with globally distributed teams

postings.title: Data Scientist
postings.offices: Graz Office; Haarlem Office; Ljubljana Office
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team in developing high-quality, validated markers that extract insights from dense temporal stacks of satellite imagery across agriculture, land management, and climate. The markers you build form the core of our Area Monitoring System (AMS) delivered to Common Agricultural Policy paying agencies across Europe, owned end-to-end from method to production code. You will collaborate closely with scientists and engineers to deploy models at scale, while expanding beyond compliance into land-cover change detection using embeddings and AI-first workflows.

Ideal candidates are adaptable, curious about AI agents, and eager to iterate directly based on customer feedback. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to work with multi-sensor Earth observation data to solve complex environmental and agricultural challenges.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Graz, Ljubljana or Haarlem office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Develop algorithms and machine learning models that extract insights from satellite imagery time series, and maintain and improve the markers we already run.

- Take a research topic from exploration through to production.

- Own marker results for production AMS deliveries across several EU countries — run them, review them, and confirm quality before they reach the client.

- Explore and build embeddings-based insight extraction in new areas beyond CAP.

- Use AI agents in your daily work, and help the team get better at it.

- Co-own the markers codebase together with the rest of the team.

- Collaborate with the team to iteratively build solutions on our platform and existing data building blocks, and inspire and enable our partners to extract insights using them.

- Document and organize your work to be transparent and repeatable.

- Write internal research reports, public blog posts, and reports for clients.

What You Bring:

- 4+ years of relevant work experience.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, data science, or another STEM field.

- Understanding of machine learning principles, including model validation and performance evaluation techniques.

- Proficiency in Python programming, with the ability to write maintainable, well-documented code.

- Experience working with AI agents and modern machine learning tools.

- Experience with version control and Git, and comfort working in a shared codebase.

- Working knowledge of the geospatial domain.

- Ability to deliver projects on schedule and manage technical deliverables.

- Problem-solving skills in technical or analytical domains.

- Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience working with embeddings or other learned representations of imagery.

- Remote sensing expertise, particularly with satellite time series.

- Experience processing radar data (for example Sentinel-1).

- Familiarity with the agricultural domain, or with the EU Common Agricultural Policy and area-based payment schemes.

- Experience with cloud environments and distributed computing.

The markers you build form the core of our Area Monitoring System (AMS) delivered to Common Agricultural Policy paying agencies across Europe, owned end-to-end from method to production code. - Develop algorithms and machine learning models that extract insights from satellite imagery time series, and maintain and improve the markers we already run.

- Explore and build embeddings-based insight extraction in new areas beyond CAP.

- Use AI agents in your daily work, and help the team get better at it.

- Co-own the markers codebase together with the rest of the team.

- Collaborate with the team to iteratively build solutions on our platform and existing data building blocks, and inspire and enable our partners to extract insights using them.

- Document and organize your work to be transparent and repeatable.

- Write internal research reports, public blog posts, and reports for clients.

- 4+ years of relevant work experience.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, data science, or another STEM field.

- Understanding of machine learning principles, including model validation and performance evaluation techniques.

- Proficiency in Python programming, with the ability to write maintainable, well-documented code.

- Experience working with AI agents and modern machine learning tools.

- Experience with version control and Git, and comfort working in a shared codebase.

- Working knowledge of the geospatial domain.

- Ability to deliver projects on schedule and manage technical deliverables.

- Problem-solving skills in technical or analytical domains.

- Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

- Experience working with embeddings or other learned representations of imagery.

- Remote sensing expertise, particularly with satellite time series.

- Experience processing radar data (for example Sentinel-1).

- Familiarity with the agricultural domain, or with the EU Common Agricultural Policy and area-based payment schemes.

- Experience with cloud environments and distributed computing.

This position requires close coordination with both internal and external constituencies, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with Planet’s customers, federal agencies, NGOs, technical partners and team members around the world, in a highly-dynamic, high-growth commercial company. Planet’s services are novel, and thus we are looking for someone to simultaneously educate stakeholders on the broader context of commercial aerospace opportunities while also specifically advancing short-term opportunities for Planet.

postings.title: Director of Pre-Sales, Global Defence & Intelligence
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Director of Pre-Sales, Global Defence & Intelligence (D&I) will be responsible for leading Pre-Sales Solution Architects worldwide. This leader will deliver excellence in technical sales, account strategy, relationship building, and solution architecting tailored specifically to national security, Defence & Intelligence institutions.

The mission of Pre-Sales is to provide trusted technical advice, enabling global defence customers to leverage Earth Observation data and geospatial intelligence to support critical military operations, decision-making, and strategic outcomes.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished people manager, a geospatial expert with strong commercial acumen, and possesses over 10 years of experience in Defence & Intelligence. You possess a deep understanding of government defense customers, complex procurement frameworks, and military command structures.

This is a visible, strategic, and highly influential global role, partnering closely with internal D&I Sales teams, Space Systems, Product Engineering, and trusted defense partner ecosystems to secure complex, large-scale government contracts.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the UK or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Create the conditions for high performance; recruit, coach, and develop a global team of specialized D&I Pre-Sales Solution Architects.

- Support global D&I sales teams and partner ecosystems by providing world-class technical sales capability to win new defense programs and expand existing accounts.

- Apply deep expertise in remote sensing, imagery analytics, and complex data architecture to design solutions supporting Military Operations, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) workflows.

- Lead high-impact customer engagements, workshops, pilots, and technical demonstrations tailored to defense commanders, intelligence analysts, and procurement officers.

- Collaborate closely with Global Professional Services, Program Management and Customer Success to conduct rigorous technical assessments, ensuring flawless execution from validation to operational delivery.

- Feed insights, security requirements, and intelligence use cases directly back to Product and Marketing to shape the product roadmap.

- Serve as a core member of the Global Pre-Sales & Services leadership team, shaping overarching department strategy and driving execution.

What You Bring:

- 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing and scaling technical sales (Pre-Sales / Solution Architecture) teams.

- 8+ years of professional experience in a Defence & Intelligence environment.

- Active Security Clearance (or eligibility to hold suitable clearance for engaging all levels of Military Command).

- Solid grasp of military planning, intelligence workflows, and how commercial Earth Observation (EO) data integrates into defense decision-making.

- Experience navigating complex government sales cycles, RFP/RFI processes, and defense contracting frameworks.

- Fluency in geospatial system architectures, cloud environments/secure deployments, API integrations, and complex data pipelines.

- Ability to engage senior defense executives, military leaders, and procurement authorities, translating technical complexity into strategic value.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills with a track record of building resilient, high-trust teams.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Military / Veteran Experience: Former active Armed Forces Reserve or veteran intelligence professional.

- Experience working with Sales Qualification frameworks and methodologies e.g., Challenger Sales, MEDDPICC.

- Understanding of AI-Driven Geospatial Innovation: Conversant in modern AI/ML capabilities (e.g., automated feature extraction, change detection, foundation models) and skilled at leveraging AI to demonstrate high-value intelligence outcomes to defense customers—moving beyond raw imagery to automated, actionable insights.

- Experience co-selling and architecting solutions alongside major defense prime contractors, system integrators, and international allies.

As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Kingdom or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.

- Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.

- Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.

- Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.

- Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.

- Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.

- Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.

- Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.

- Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

- 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.

- Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.

- Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).

- Extensive background navigating complex government, NATO, and defense procurement frameworks (e.g., NCI Agency, FMS/DCS, national MoD acquisition bodies) across Northern Europe and Allied Command structures, with a focus on key Nordic nations (Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark).

- An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.

- Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.

- Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.

- A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.

- Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.

- Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.

- Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.

- Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.

About the Role:

The Director of Sales, Middle East will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors. In this highly strategic role, you will lead high-performing teams, build executive relationships across defense ministries and key contractors, and position Planet's Earth observation platform as an essential capability for mission-critical operations. Ideal candidates are ambitious commercial leaders with deep defense domain expertise, exceptional strategic vision, and a passion for driving transformational business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams in the region. You will bring an established executive network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, and key Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Arab Emirates. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week

Impact You’ll Own:

- Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.

- Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.

- Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.

- Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.

- Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.

- Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.

- Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams—including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing—to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.

- Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.

- Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

- 8+ years of experience with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual & team quotas.

- 6+ years of progressive leadership and management experience.

- Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.

- Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).

- Extensive background navigating complex government and defense procurement frameworks across the Middle East, with a primary focus on key markets including the UAE, KSA, Oman, and Bahrain.

- An established, C-level network across Ministries of Defense, Intelligence Agencies, and Tier-1 Prime Contractors / System Integrators in the MENA region.

- Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support sovereign defense, intelligence, and national security missions.

- Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.

- A strategic, self-directed leader with sound commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.

- Deep operational understanding of defense domain priorities, sovereign procurement frameworks, and agency decision-making processes across the UK and EMEA regions.

- Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.

- Fluency in both English and Arabic is a solid plus, enabling the candidate to articulate complex strategic value propositions effectively to senior government ministers, agency leaders, and internal executives.

About the Role:

As the Director of Software Engineering, Analytics, you will lead, staff, and scale the engineering organization that builds Planet’s analytics: the models and pipelines that turn daily satellite imagery into answers about what changed at a site, what is moving in a port, and what is being built across a country. These analytics power Planet’s dual-use products such as Global Monitoring Service (GMS) and Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) for defense use cases, and are expanding into commercial and civil government use through the same models and platform.

You will lead engineering managers and engineers across Denver, Washington DC, remote North America, and Europe. You will be responsible for building the team, the plan, the delivery, and the operating model and will report to the VP of Technology. This is a build role: the organization is moving from hand-built detectors to foundation-model-based methods, scaling from hundreds of monitored sites to thousands, and operating across classified and unclassified environments.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Denver or Washington DC office 3 days per week. This role requires US person status and the ability to obtain and hold a US government security clearance.

Impact You'll Own:

- Engineering Leadership & Staffing: Develop and execute a talent strategy supporting our product roadmap. Build a staffing plan and develop, recruit, and hire talent accordingly. Manage performance directly and build bench depth to limit single points of failure.

- Delivery & Cross-Team Contracts: Turn program commitments into dated, owned work and report status plainly, including slippage. Own the analytics side of the interface with the Global Monitoring Service (GMS) and Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) application teams and deliver against the shared quality and latency targets.

- Classified & Unclassified Operating Model: Define and execute a strategy for developing models that serve classified and unclassified environments. Serving the needs of customers in classified spaces while keeping the models themselves dual-use.

- Foundation Model Transition: Build a strategy for how to evolve our existing portfolio of analytics to stay up to date with the latest developments in foundation models.

- Cost & Capacity: Know what each pipeline costs per site and per square kilometer, and plan for the ten-times scale-up that contract growth implies.

What You Bring:

- 8+ years of experience in software or machine learning engineering, with a focus on computer vision, geospatial analytics, or high-scale data systems.

- 6+ years of experience leading engineering teams, including direct experience managing engineering managers and growing an organization through a scaling step.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

- Track record of shipping machine learning, computer vision, or geospatial analytics into production and owning the results.

- Direct experience leading engineering work governed by International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), with cleared and uncleared staff on the same team.

- Success pairing with a solid technical lead or architect who owned technical direction while you owned people, plan, and delivery.

- Ability to write a clear plan and a clear status report, and to drive delivery against dated commitments.

- Defense or intelligence customer exposure, including working directly with operators and analysts.

- US person status and an active US government security clearance, or eligibility to obtain one upon hire (TS/SCI preferred).

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Remote Sensing, or a related technical discipline.

- Experience leading a computer vision team through a shift from task-specific models to foundation models or embeddings.

- Experience delivering analytics into classified, air-gapped, or sovereign cloud environments (e.g., AWS GovCloud/C2S) and knowing what breaks.

- Experience integrating an acquired team or merging two engineering groups.

- Domain knowledge in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), maritime, or activity-based intelligence work.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As a Ground Station Engineer at Planet you will be a member of the Planet Ground Stations Operations Team focused on the delivery and operational excellence of a geographically diverse Ground Station network. The network is composed of a mix of physical antennas, network and compute resources, cloud infrastructure and industrial controllers working in unison to autonomously track and communicate with Planet’s multiple satellite constellations.

Planet’s satellites generate a substantial dataset and moving that data from our spacecraft across the Ground Station network daily poses ever changing design goals for our Operations Team. The Ground Station team works closely with Spacecraft Operators and Mission Control engineers to autonomously control the spacecraft and bring the data back to Earth.

As a Ground Station Engineer overseeing the installation of complex systems that are critical to Planet’s ongoing operations, you will be required to regularly exercise discretion, independent judgment, and will be expected to make decisions independent of oversight as needed.

An essential element of this position requires the ability to climb, and lift/push/pull equipment up to 50 pounds. A drivers license and clean driving record will be required as well as the ability to operate vehicles in foreign countries.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Collaborate with the Logistics and Service Delivery Managers to facilitate the deployment of hardware and essential materials to emerging ground station locations.

- Direct and manage all on-site implementation and construction tasks.

- Partner with internal Finance units to ensure rigorous asset tracking and accounting for deployed infrastructure.

- Provide consistent and detailed progress updates regarding the technical installation lifecycle.

What You Bring:

- 4+ years of experience in antenna system installation or maintenance.

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in RF Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or similar specialized technical field

- Experience in organizational management and high-volume task prioritization.

- Familiarity with RF test equipment such as spectrum and network analyzers.

- Willingness to travel up to 75% of the time.

- Ability to work with little or no supervision. Discretion to make independent decisions.

- Advanced understanding of RF communication and satellite communication protocols.

- 2+ years experience with RF electronics and communication systems including: RF front-end equipment, back-end equipment, communication hardware, and link budgets.

- Antenna system calibration, diagnostics and monitoring experience.

- 2+ years experience with telemetry, tracking and control systems.

- 2-4 years project management and logistics experience.

- Radar and/or comms experience.

- Experience with Linux or UNIX servers.

This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and built on solid engineering and operational fundamentals.

- Exposure to enterprise observability stack configuration and telemetry practices.

The Electro-Optical Systems team at Planet is seeking an Opto-Mechanical Engineer to help drive the design of payloads in Planet’s fleet of Earth-imaging satellites. Your mission will be to champion our payload design efforts, with a specific focus on opto-mechanical design and manufacturing. The ideal candidate will be a seasoned opto-mechanical designer who has led optical system engineering efforts across multiple programs from conceptual design through flight. As a member of the Electro-Optical Systems team within Planet’s Space Systems division, you will be a key contributor and stakeholder in Planet’s agile aerospace approach to spacecraft design, and will work hand-in-glove with optical engineering, structural analysis, thermal engineering, and reliability & qualification, as well as the rest of Planet’s leading-edge spacecraft design and manufacturing teams.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in our San Francisco HQ 5 days per week.

- Own the opto-mechanical manufacturing process of optical payloads on Planet’s next-generation satellites

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as structural, thermal analysts and optical engineer groups to drive and perform analyses to ensure payloads meet stiffness, strength, thermal, and launch survivability requirements, as well as maintain on-orbit performance through STOP (Structural, Thermal, Optical Performance)

- Drive part and assembly design, manage fabrication with key vendors, perform failure analysis, and execute tolerance stackup and GD&T analyses to ensure precision and reliability

- Develop and maintain comprehensive design documentation

- Lead technical presentations and reviews across all design review gates

- Support test planning and qualification test campaigns

- Be hands-on with flight and test hardware

What You Bring:

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.

- 4+ years experience owning the development of opto-mechanical products from requirements through conceptual design, testing and manufacturing

- Experience designing for high-reliability space environments including launch survivability, vacuum conditions, on-orbit performance through thermal conditions (STOP)

- Experience in the design and fabrication of optical assemblies, incorporating components made from glass, carbon fiber, metals, ceramics, epoxies, as well as mechanisms and electrical elements

- Practical and direct engagement with hardware, from prototyping to production and testing phases

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

- Experience working in a dynamic environment while driving projects to completion

- Good verbal and visual communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Expertise in optics / opto-mechanical manufacturing, metrology, alignment and calibration

- Ability to build out the manufacturing line for precision optical systems

- Experience with dynamic hardware builds, vibration and shock testing, telescope assembly, and optical performance testing

- Experience applying systems engineering principles to optimize optical payload integration, focusing on requirements management, trade-off analysis, and balancing system-level constraints such as cost, schedule, and performance

- Ability to drive manufacturers and DFM/DFA

- Proficiency in SolidWorks, Zemax, Matlab, Visual Basic, Python and/or C/C++

postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

You will work within a small team of dedicated engineers responsible for the design of Planet’s satellites. This is not your typical aerospace or consumer electronics role. You will work designing printed circuit board assemblies optimized for medium-scale mass production. You will design and optimize electrical power, data handling, and sensor interfacing systems, both within the spacecraft and on ground support equipment. You will be responsible for complex high-speed digital, analog, RF and Microwave PCB/PCBA designs and interfacing with electrical design engineers to make sure that board meets their design requirements. You will work with board manufacturers to ensure they are fabricating and assembling a quality product. Your work will then be put in a rocket and shot into space.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Design layout of RF/Microwave, power, microprocessor, high-speed interface, and mixed-signal Printed Circuit Boards for satellite applications in concert with the electrical design engineers

- Collaborate with electrical design engineers and supply chain to manage PCB design in Altium environment and the integration with the configuration control, inventory, and manufacturing system

- Coordinate with vendors to ensure on-time delivery of high-quality, high-reliability PCB Assemblies that meet IPC standards

- Generate fabrication and assembly packages, including drawings, and management of design and drawing templates

- Create parts entries, including footprints and schematic symbols, for the Altium database parts library

- Manage the Altium parts library

- Partner with electrical design engineers to manage subcontractors performing PCB layouts of their designs and reviewing their outputs

- Select PCB material and fabrication processes

What You Bring:

- 5+ years experience in PCB layout design

- Experience with Altium Designer

- Experience implementing and enforcing IPC standards for PCB design, fabrication, and assembly

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience withDesign for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Test (DFT) checks, running design rule checks (DRCs).

- Experience with quality management, i.e. addressing quality issues with vendors resulting in corrective actions

- Experience with high density, flex and rigid-flex PCB design and boards using RF material.

postings.title: Revenue Accounting Transformation Manager
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Planet is seeking a high-impact Revenue Accounting Transformation Manager to lead the modernization, automation, and scalability of our global revenue engine, reporting to the Global Revenue Accounting Director.

In this role, you will stand at the intersection of technical accounting standards (ASC 606), business systems engineering, and data analytics. You will lead cross-functional transformation across the entire Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) lifecycle. From evaluating new monetization models and designing system configurations to automating audit disclosures and acting as the primary SOX compliance liaison, you will ensure our accounting operations scale effortlessly alongside business growth. You will serve as the architectural bridge between commercial innovation, technical revenue compliance, and automated data pipelines—ensuring the company scales rapidly without sacrificing auditability or operational speed.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- System Architecture: Lead the design and configuration of automated revenue subledgers.

- Q2C Streamlining: Modernize end-to-end Quote-to-Cash workflows to eliminate manual journal entries, eradicate spreadsheet risks, and shorten month-end close cycles.

- Cross-System Data Alignment: Collaborate with cross functional teams to integrate revenue data across ERP, subledgers, and data warehouses.

- Footnote & Executive Dashboards: Automate ASC 606 footnote disclosures and key financial metrics with automated reconciliations.

- Commercial Strategy Engagement: Partner with Product, Sales Ops, and Pricing teams to evaluate systems impact and revenue rules (ASC 606) for new products and monetization models.

- Audit Ownership: Serve as the primary liaison for internal and external auditors on revenue systems, process changes, and automation workflows.

- Control Design: Design, document, and test key SOX application controls and risk matrices resulting from system upgrades and new product launches.

- Standards Adherence: Ensure all automated system rules, data flows, and manual overrides remain strictly compliant with ASC 606.

- Change Management: Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and train finance teams on updated system workflows.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of revenue accounting experience (combining Big 4 accounting and high-growth corporate finance experience is strongly preferred).

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Information Systems, or comparable.

- Excellent understanding of US GAAP and ASC 606 principles in a complex SaaS, recurring revenue, multi-element, or usage-based business models.

- Hands-on experience with SOX 404 compliance, internal control frameworks, and leading audit walk-throughs for automated IT application controls.

- Direct experience implementing, configuring, or managing enterprise ERPs and revenue subledgers/engines (NetSuite ARM, Salesforce, etc.).

- Proficiency with enterprise data warehouses and BI/visualization tools; solid database query/SQL skills are highly valued.

postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Image Quality Support (IQS) makes sure Planet's imagery meets that bar. We sit between imaging operations, satellite operations, software engineering, and the business — close enough to engineering to build our own tools, close enough to customers to know what "quality" means to them.

We're looking for a Satellite Data Processing Engineer to help assess and automate imagery quality across Planet's satellite fleet. You'll split your time between hands-on visual QA and writing the software that scales it — a hybrid of remote-sensing know-how and software engineering, building up both with guidance from senior teammates.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Assess satellite imagery, manually and via automated tooling, against contractual and technical quality standards.

- Help build and maintain the internal tools that power quality assessment — from QGIS-based QA tooling to backend scripts and data pipelines.

- Support investigations into customer-reported quality disputes, gathering technical evidence for the team's decisions.

- Contribute to the team's automated quality-assessment systems, helping shift routine checks from manual review into automation.

- Write clear reports and tickets that other engineering teams can act on.

What You Bring:

- 2+ years of relevant experience.

- Bachelor’s degree in geoinformatics, geomatics, remote sensing, or a closely related field.

- A working understanding of optical remote sensing fundamentals.

- Solid Python skills: comfortable with version control, code review, and writing more than one-off scripts.

- Exposure to QGIS or Python geospatial libraries (e.g. GDAL, rasterio, shapely).

- Basic SQL / database familiarity.

- Clear written communication: you can explain a technical finding to a non-specialist.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Linux comfort.

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI).

- Any exposure to desktop GUI development (e.g. PySide6/Qt) or building small internal tools end-to-end.

This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Planet seeks a Senior Camera Systems Engineer to serve as the primary system architect and technical lead for our next-generation satellite camera modules. In this role, you will bridge the gap between mission-level imaging goals and hardware implementation, orchestrating the end-to-end lifecycle of our camera systems. You will drive requirements flowdown, lead cross-functional trade studies, and manage key technical relationships with external image sensor and camera component vendors.

You will collaborate closely with Electrical, Mechanical, Thermal, Optical, and Flight Software teams to optimize the camera system to meet our tight SWaP-C (Size, Weight, Power, Cost, and Schedule) and electro-optical performance targets.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Translate top-level remote sensing performance requirements into clear, verifiable specifications for the camera subsystem (including image sensor, proximity electronics, lens/optical interfaces, and thermal management).

- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for external image sensor foundries and camera component vendors; drive statement of work (SOW) definitions, technical milestones, and critical design reviews (PDR/CDR).

- Lead camera-level trade studies balancing image quality attributes (SNR, dynamic range, MTF, radiometry) against spacecraft constraints like power consumption, thermal dissipation, and mass.

- Define and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs) mapping the boundaries between the camera module, high-speed data serialization, the image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, and the host payload/spacecraft bus.

- Own the end-to-end verification matrix for the camera; design and oversee the execution of environmental qualification plans (vacuum, thermal, vibration) and electro-optical calibration routines.

What You Bring:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field.

- 10+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated to systems engineering or technical leadership for complex digital cameras or electro-optical (EO) imaging systems.

- Track record of managing requirements traceability and flowdown across electrical, mechanical, and optical boundaries

- Experience managing external vendors, foundries, or contract manufacturers for high-performance camera components or custom sensors.

- Deep understanding of CMOS image sensor architecture, radiometry, and camera performance budgets (e.g., tracking noise, stray light, and MTF across the camera module).

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience developing camera hardware or imaging instruments for the LEO environment, including knowledge of radiation mitigation, outgassing, and vacuum-compatible design.

- Experience applying aerospace standards (NASA, ESA, or high-reliability commercial equivalents) to camera qualification, environmental testing, and hardware acceptance.

- Familiarity with hardware-level image processing (e.g., dark current correction, defective pixel masking), high-speed serialization protocols, and ground-station image calibration.

About the Role:

Planet's mission is to image the entire Earth every day and make global change visible, accessible, and actionable. Delivering on that mission depends on our ability to attract exceptional people across engineering, manufacturing, commercial, and corporate teams. This role leads the strategy, operating model, and team behind how Planet finds, attracts, and hires that talent.

As Senior Director, Talent Acquisition, you will own Planet's global hiring strategy and lead a Talent Team distributed across multiple regions. You will build the operating model that turns headcount plans into predictable hiring outcomes, own the external partner ecosystem, and serve as the executive voice for talent acquisition across the company. You will report to the Chief People Officer and partner closely with leaders company-wide.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Set and drive Planet's global talent acquisition strategy, and build, lead, and develop a high-performing Talent Team distributed across multiple regions.

- Own the recruiting operating model — capacity planning, forecasting, process design, and analytics — so that hiring delivers predictably against the company's growth plan.

- Partner with executive leadership and hiring managers across the company to translate headcount plans into hiring outcomes.

- Own talent acquisition operations, systems, and reporting, ensuring the function runs on clean data and clear, consistent process.

- Build and manage the external partner ecosystem that extends Planet's reach into specialized and global talent markets.

- Champion an outstanding candidate experience, a compelling employer brand, and inclusive, equitable hiring practices.

- Use data to measure hiring outcomes, continuously improve them, and report progress and forecasts to senior leadership.

What You Bring:

- 10+ years of experience leading talent acquisition at scale in a high-growth organization, including building and managing geographically distributed teams.

- 8+ years of people-leadership experience: hiring, coaching, and developing recruiters, sourcers, coordinators, and recruiting managers.

- A track record of designing and operating a recruiting model built on capacity planning, forecasting, process, and analytics — not reactive, req-by-req execution.

- Experience hiring for technical and specialized roles, ideally in engineering, hardware, or other complex disciplines.

- Ability to partner with, advise, and influence executives and senior hiring leaders.

- Experience selecting and managing external staffing partners and vendor relationships.

- Fluency with recruiting systems and data — applicant tracking, reporting, and analytics — and a habit of using metrics to guide decisions.

- Experience hiring across multiple regions, including outside the United States.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience scaling a talent acquisition function in aerospace, hardware, deep tech, or other complex engineering environments.

- Experience building or maturing recruiting operations, analytics, or capacity-planning capabilities.

- Familiarity with global employment considerations across EMEA and APAC.

- Experience integrating AI or automation into recruiting workflows.

As a Senior Engineering Program Manager (EPM) at Planet you will sit at the intersection of our hardware, engineering, and external partnerships to drive complex spacecraft programs from inception to launch. You will help set strategy, drive problem-solving efforts, eliminate roadblocks, execute on schedule, and you will be responsible for managing and communicating status and issues along the way. The ideal candidate has deep technical expertise and experience in multiple areas of spacecraft design and manufacturing.

- Oversee execution of technical plans at all levels, both internally and with external suppliers, including project definition, budgeting, and long-term strategic planning.

- Collaborate and coordinate with external stakeholders, including suppliers, partners, vendors, and customers, to manage deliverables, technical plans, and program milestones.

- Coordinate schedules, priorities, and status updates with engineering, manufacturing, teams, stakeholders, and management.

- Work directly with multiple engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive productivity and progress on concurrent projects.

- Develop tools and processes to measure and improve engineering productivity.

- Drive root cause problem-solving, identify, and eliminate blocking issues.

- Lead manufacturing ramp programs from early factory engagement and readiness through key build phases into production.

- 10+ years of relevant experience of program management in aerospace, manufacturing or similar industry.

- Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Proficiency in spoken and written German and professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

- Experience working with and managing external contract manufacturers (CMs), suppliers, and vendors to drive program success.

- Ability to travel internationally, specifically to San Francisco about 2-3 times a year.
