About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior FP&A Revenue Manager who will build out a world-class revenue forecasting and analysis process for our high-growth business. The role will focus on analyzing and defining key revenue drivers, including by channel, geography, and cohort. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our business by working side by side with our Business Intelligence team, Operational Managers, Accounting, and Company leadership. You’ll have an immediate impact, owning and developing the comprehensive revenue forecast for the Company. You will be working closely with our business, accounting, and Investor Relations team to build a reliable and transparent forecast framework for the business, and you will report to the Sr. Director of FP&A. The ideal candidate possesses a mix of analytical rigor, financial planning expertise, and cross-functional leadership skills.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Forecasting & Modeling Excellence

- Own the end-to-end annual budgeting and monthly/quarterly forecasting cycles for all revenue and related metrics.

- Build & maintain sophisticated quantitative models to improve revenue forecasting/planning. Identify and coordinate improvements to existing models and systems.

- The revenue modeling work has an entrepreneurial component, which requires a strong understanding of our current reporting and modeling ecosystem and motivating changes to improve accuracy and explainability.

- Be the domain expert on all things revenue.

- Help facilitate the preparation of forecasts by coordinating with key business partners on items such as: bookings assumptions, revenue recognition, and usage assumptions.

- Insights & Strategic Partnership

- Drive actionable insights by performing detailed variance analysis (Actuals vs. Forecast vs. Budget) and clearly articulating the financial story to executive leadership.

- This role requires discovering and presenting insights about how organic trends and business decisions impact Planet’s revenue growth trajectory.

- Preparation of Executive-level presentations summarizing revenue performance, key variances, and future outlook for the Board and Senior Leadership.

- Work closely with the Accounting team to ensure alignment between revenue recognition principles and forecasting methodologies (ASC 606 implications).

- Participate in key strategic initiatives and assist with other ad hoc projects supporting business partners and finance leadership.

- Systems & Process Improvement

- Automate and improve planning and reporting processes, working with the BI team to enhance the "single source of truth" for revenue data.

- Accountable for ad-hoc initiatives in critical business analysis and key projects.

What You Bring:

- 10+ years of progressive experience working in an FP&A revenue role, or a combination of auditing/revenue accounting/investment banking and FP&A roles.

- Strong experience with consumption-based or usage-based revenue models, including tracking product usage telemetry, and understanding revenue recognition rules (e.g., ASC 606).

- Deep experience in analytics and financial modeling, particularly in building complex, dynamic models from scratch, and tracking forecasting models.

- Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills with proven ability to clearly and succinctly explain complex model characteristics and their results to leadership.

- Familiarity with common financial concepts, including basics of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and FX impact estimates.

- Ability to cut to the heart of and articulate issues, scope and select recommended solutions, and implement them.

- Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, Sales, and Business Intelligence teams.

- Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment; dependable with deliverables and deadlines, able to multi-task while maintaining an emphasis on quality.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience with usage-based revenue model highly preferred.

- Experience using programming skills for data analysis (Tableau, SQL, and Python/R programming skills).

- Experience working with Business Intelligence to build models and reporting.

- Proven ability to work with and synthesize data from core financial and CRM systems (such as Excel, Salesforce CPQ, Netsuite, ARM, Pigment, and BI tools).

- Big 4 experience or investment banking experience.

- Experience in a high-growth, rapidly changing work environment.

- Ability to work with a strong sense of urgency both as an individual contributor and as a team leader.

postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.

- Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.

- Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.

- Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.

- Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.

- Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.

- Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

- Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.

- Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.

- Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.

- Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.

- Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.

- Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.

- Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.

- Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal), batch and job-execution systems, or large-scale data processing pipelines.

- Experience defining and measuring platform adoption: developer-productivity instrumentation, NPS, or internal marketshare.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will drive hands-on engineering and modeling for Defense and Intelligence applications. You’ll implement novel embeddings-based change detection and advanced computer vision techniques. In this role, you will ensure best-in-class testing and deploy solutions to run at continental and global scales. You’ll collaborate closely with data scientists and software engineers to drive innovation in remote sensing and large-scale geospatial analytics. Ideal candidates bring a creative mindset and passion for solving complex geospatial challenges.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Arlington, VA office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Spearhead the development of novel algorithms and machine learning models tailored for Defense and Intelligence applications.

- Optimize model performance to execute high-throughput inference at continental and global scales.

- Innovate computer vision, time series, and embeddings-based techniques to uncover new insights from satellite data.

- Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to define requirements and iterate on algorithm designs.

- Integrate ML pre-processing and inference pipelines seamlessly with adjacent software engineering platforms.

- Establish best-in-class testing, validation, and monitoring frameworks for continuous model reliability.

What You Bring:

- 10+ years of relevant experience of which 6+ years of experience is in machine learning.

- Ability to conduct a rigorous evaluation of results and internal communication of algorithm failure modes.

- Expertise with data science, time series methods, computer vision, and embeddings.

- Ability to implement, train, and optimize neural networks.

- Experience wrangling large datasets, ideally with geospatial libraries, combined with frameworks like PyTorch/TF for model development and training.

- Ability to experiment with model architectures, and derive data-driven insights to iteratively improve performance and accuracy.

- Experience writing clean, modular Python code and applying software development best practices (Git, testing, CI/CD).

- Experience deploying models (via Docker, Kubernetes, or similar) with an understanding of best practices for monitoring and maintaining them at scale.

- AWS or GCP experience

- Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to diverse audiences.

- Graduate degree in a STEM or analytics-focused field or equivalent work experience.

- Located in the Washington, DC metro or ability to work and commute to Arlington, VA 3x/week

- Ability to obtain and maintain US Security Clearance

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Practical knowledge of remote sensing, satellite imagery, or related geospatial domains

- Knowledge of coordinate reference systems, geometry manipulations, and common data formats (GeoTIFF, GeoJSON, etc).

- Hands-on experience building geospatial or sensor-driven data products from scratch

- Familiarity with techniques like model compression, GPU optimizations, or distributed training pipelines

postings.title: Senior Manager, Talent Operations
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Planet is executing one of its most ambitious hiring years — onboarding hundreds of new team members across multiple geographies to deliver on our growth plan, launch a second manufacturing hub in Berlin, and scale our Earth intelligence products to market. Behind every hire is a complex operational machine: ATS workflows, interview scheduling, offer approvals, compliance checks, onboarding handoffs, and dozens of process touchpoints that determine whether a candidate has a world-class experience or drops out of the funnel.

As Senior Manager, Talent Operations, you will own that machine. You will lead a team of operations specialists, recruiting coordinators, and support staff that keeps the entire hiring lifecycle running smoothly — from requisition creation through offer acceptance. You will drive the Talent Operations Roadmap, which includes active projects spanning AI interview assessment tool deployment, global process standardization, headcount approval flow redesign, SLA audits, and interview process documentation.

This role sits at the intersection of process design, technology, compliance, and candidate experience. You will be responsible for ensuring that our operational infrastructure scales at the same pace as our hiring ambitions — and that every touchpoint in the recruiting process reflects the quality and rigor candidates expect from a company building technology that monitors the entire planet.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Talent Acquisition and Talent Management. You will partner closely with the Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition to ensure that the operational data flowing out of your systems — pipeline velocity, stage conversion rates, scheduling throughput — feeds directly into the capacity model that drives recruiting resource allocation. This is a critical role. This hire will immediately unblock a significant body of work and drive operational leadership to a function that touches every hire the company makes.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Own and execute the Talent Operations Roadmap — a portfolio of active projects including AI assessment tool evaluation and rollout, global process standardization, headcount approval flow redesign, SLA audit and enforcement, and interview training program development.

- Lead and develop a team of operations and coordination professionals across multiple offices, setting priorities, coaching on operational excellence, and ensuring coordination coverage meets the needs of a growing recruiting team.

- Drive scorecard SLA compliance to target by implementing process controls, automated reminders, and accountability mechanisms within the ATS — turning a lagging metric into a leading indicator of interview quality.

- Reduce time-to-fill by identifying and streamlining operational bottlenecks — particularly in interview scheduling, offer approval workflows, and pre-offer document processing.

- Operationalize the selected AI interview assessment tool across the full recruiting team, including training, change management, hiring manager onboarding, and usage analytics tracking.

- Own ATS administration, configuration, and optimization — including custom workflows, approval chains, reporting dashboards, offer templates, and compliance-driven fields for global hiring across multiple entities and geographies.

- Lead the headcount approval flow redesign — documenting the current state, mapping the ideal state, building automated workflows, and launching with clear communication and documentation.

- Ensure onboarding compliance for all new hires across multiple geographies, working closely with People Operations to hand off candidates cleanly and verify all pre-hire documentation including background checks, export control clearances, work authorization, and international entity requirements.

- Build and maintain the talent operations knowledge base — ensuring all processes, policies, and SLAs are documented, current, and accessible to the recruiting team and hiring managers.

- Partner with the Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition to provide the operational data that feeds the capacity model — including pipeline velocity metrics, stage conversion rates, and scheduling throughput — so that resource allocation decisions are grounded in real process performance.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of experience in talent operations, or HR operations.

- 4+ years managing a team of coordinators and operations specialists at a scaling technology company.

- Deep expertise with Greenhouse ATS or a comparable enterprise applicant tracking system, including administration, workflow configuration, custom reporting, and integration management.

- Experience driving SLA compliance and process adherence across a distributed recruiting team — you have built the dashboards, set the targets, and held people accountable.

postings.offices: Berlin Office; Graz Office; Haarlem Office; Ljubljana Office
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The design team at Planet is looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape Planet's platform experience (insights.planet.com - free trial available). In this role, you will be responsible for defining the core user journeys across our platform, addressing the needs of different user types (from admins, to developers, to end users). With a relentless focus on those users, you will define jobs-to-be-done and design end-to-end user flows across web frontends and agentic workflows. You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to decompose these workflows into scalable, reusable UX building blocks, ultimately crafting a cohesive, user-centric platform experience.

The perfect candidate brings a track record of designing sophisticated, data-heavy geospatial applications. This role is full stack, in the design sense: you take a problem from discovery with users all the way to designing and building the interfaces, side by side with our engineers.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin or Haarlem office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Product Design Ownership: Lead the end-to-end process from discovery and prototyping to high-fidelity design.

- Geospatial Interface Design: Create intuitive, powerful geospatial interfaces that translate complex data into actionable insights.

- User Research: Gather feedback and conduct user interviews in close collaboration with product partners.

- UI Architecture: Define and architect the interaction patterns and design system for Planet’s platform.

- Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to ensure top-tier design quality.

- Culture: Help build and elevate Planet's design culture.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years designing complex digital products, with a track record of shipping technical, SaaS, or B2B software end to end.

- Bachelor’s degree in design or an equivalent field.

- A portfolio with geospatial or data analytics work: interactive maps, layered geospatial data and time series (time sliders, change over time, comparisons), plus the statistics and charts that turn data into an insight.

- Solid core craft in UX/UI, interaction design, prototyping, accessibility, and visual design, plus Figma and enterprise design systems.

- An AI-native way of working. You can prototype in code with AI coding assistants, and you're comfortable with Git and merge requests.

- Research you run yourself: user interviews and usability testing, synthesized into clear product direction.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You take vague, complex problems and drive them to a validated solution without daily oversight.

- A dynamic, iterative, low-ego way of working with PMs, engineers, and other designers.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience designing for developers, data scientists, or AI agents.

- Hands-on with remote sensing analysis and familiarity with geospatial standards.

- You enjoy meeting customers and are open to travel within Europe.

- Experience helping a team adopt new ways of working.

About the Role:

As Senior Product Manager, Defense & Intelligence (D&I) Tasking Solutions, you bridge Planet's core Tasking platform and our defense mission offerings. You will own Tip-and-Cue and the Tasking Strategy Engine—translating complex mission rules into satellite collection—while representing D&I operational needs into core platform product lines, including Constellation Services (CxS) and Real-Time Insights (RTI).

Partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will focus on technical delivery: converting recurring field integration patterns into durable, reusable platform capabilities that accelerate delivery speed across high-consequence defense environments.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco, CA or Arlington, VA office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Define how customer config-driven logic translates to sensor/constellation selection, collection cadence, multi-constellation/all-weather logic that converts mission intent into optimized satellite collection calls.

- Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers in the field to identify recurring customer integration patterns, converting them into generalizable, reusable platform features rather than one-off custom builds.

- Convert defense business rules and domain logic into dynamic tasking strategy designs, directly driving down pixel-to-insight latency.

- Consolidate inputs across field engineering, GTM/sales, and adjacent PM counterparts into a prioritized D&I Tasking Solutions roadmap.

- Collaborate closely with the Commercial Tasking, CxS and RTI product managers to ensure D&I tasking, capacity, and low-latency delivery requirements are represented in the shared platform roadmap.

- Work with compliance and security teams to ensure all products and services adhere to export control laws, national security constraints, and data privacy standards.

- Collaborate with adjacent D&I Solutions PMs (owning platform extensibility, packaging, and frontend mission workflows) to deliver a seamless end-to-end user experience.

What You Bring:

- 6 to 8 years of technical product management experience bridging core platform teams and technical field teams (FDE, Solutions Engineering).

- Solid understanding of tasking, scheduling, or workflow-orchestration systems, and enterprise integration patterns.

- Proven ability to separate generalizable platform capabilities from one-off customizations.

- Experience translating operational rules, mission logic, or domain-specific business processes into system workflows and product requirements.

- Background in geospatial intelligence, satellite tasking, or a closely related defense technology field.

- Track record of prioritizing backlogs across competing technical and operational demands.

- Experience presenting technical trade-offs and mission impact in both engineering design reviews and executive/customer briefings.

- Experience independently owning a roadmap or workstream spanning multiple concurrent priorities, with minimal day-to-day oversight.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Hands-on experience with satellite operations, orbital scheduling APIs, constellation orchestration, collection management, or event-driven machine-to-machine architectures.

- Experience scaling vertical product/solution layers on top of shared platform infrastructure.

- Active or prior U.S. Security Clearance (Secret or TS/SCI).

- Direct operational background within or supporting the U.S. Defense & Intelligence Community.

This role asks for real depth in the mission. You'll need to understand the people involved in this work — intelligence analysts, operations managers, and senior political and military leadership — and what they're trying to accomplish. That understanding is what shapes our messaging and what we bring back to Product to inform where the roadmap should go. You'll partner closely with Industry Marketing, Product, Sales, and Enablement, and you'll often be the person in the room who can translate between the technology and the mission.

Impact You'll Own:

- Own the marketing plan for solutions already in the market, and lead strategy and launch for new ones, partnering with Marketing, Sales, and Enablement across the lifecycle.

- Develop the value proposition, messaging frameworks, and ICPs that align our GTM teams and speak to customers, in language they can see themselves in.

- Show how these solutions fit together and connect to the rest of Planet, and keep that clear as the portfolio grows.

- Continuously assess and improve positioning, campaigns, content, and sales effectiveness in close partnership with our GTM teams.

- Work hand-in-hand with Product, bringing customer, competitive, and market insight that sharpens how we compete.

- Build deep knowledge of the portfolio — how analysis is produced and delivered, the integration paths into customer workflows, and the roadmap — so you can explain it clearly to customer-facing teams.

- Maintain a library of product assets — solution briefs, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling, customer vignettes, and narrative-driven collateral — that are current, compelling, and highly usable for customer-facing teams.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of relevant product marketing experience with a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in B2G or B2B categories, demonstrating a strong understanding of how government and defense customers evaluate, procure, and decide.

- Track record of engaging hard-to-reach buyers with modern storytelling — video, customer-led narrative, formats built for how people actually consume content — and ability to tell a compelling story inside the constraints this market comes with.

- An AI-native builder mindset; you actively leverage AI tools in your day-to-day workflow to generate messaging, build solutions, and accelerate execution.

- Track record positioning and marketing B2B/enterprise products, specifically bringing zero-to-one AI or highly technical SaaS products to market.

- Experience partnering with product, sales, and executive stakeholders and communicating across leadership.

- Excellent organizational skills, self-starter with ability to collaborate across departments.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Direct experience with maritime domain awareness, ISR, GEOINT, or persistent monitoring mission areas.

- Proven ability to articulate complex technological futures and translate them into deeply penetrating product-market fit.

- Experience working with international sales teams

- Geospatial expertise

postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Quality Engineer to support the implementation of our quality management systems and drive process design and continuous improvement in our San Francisco manufacturing facility. In this role, you will work in close partnership with the Quality Engineer Lead to execute strategic quality objectives, enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and elevate product reliability across our manufacturing operations.

You will collaborate with a small team of quality technicians while interfacing daily with cross-functional teams including product design engineers, manufacturing personnel, test/maintenance teams, and supply chain. In addition to driving process improvement, you will remain actively engaged in hands-on quality inspection, root-cause analysis, and shop-floor troubleshooting, ensuring a solid foundation of knowledge about our parts and products. This role will appeal to individuals who enjoy strategic problem-solving, operational rigor, and mentoring others.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in our San Francisco HQ 5 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Implement Quality Management Systems: Partner directly with the Quality Engineer Lead to implement, maintain, and audit comprehensive Quality Management Systems (QMS).

- Guide and Mentor Technicians: Guide, train, and mentor quality technicians on advanced inspection techniques, blueprints, and standard operating procedures.

- Prepare for Audits and Deliver KPIs: Support internal and external vendor audit preparation, compile quality KPIs, and deliver monthly management review presentations with leadership.

- Develop Standardized Inspection Protocols: Develop and refine standardized procedures for incoming raw material inspections, in-process testing, and final product release criteria.

- Provide Daily Production Support: Provide immediate, hands-on quality engineering support to production teams to resolve line-side manufacturing non-conformances.

- Monitor Quality Metrics & Dashboards: Monitor quality metrics (yield, scrap, COPQ), track defect trends, and maintain real-time performance dashboards for quality leadership visibility.

- Optimize Manufacturing Processes: Optimize manufacturing processes from inception to validation by leading and participating in Lean Kaizen events, gap analyses, and cross-functional feedback loops.

- Execute Risk Assessments (FMEA): Lead Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) sessions alongside engineering teams to proactively identify risks and strengthen process controls.

- Reduce Waste and Improve Capability: Identify operational waste, improve overall process capability (Cpk), and reduce the cost-of-poor-quality (COPQ).

- Perform Technical Root-Cause Analysis: Perform technical inspections and perform root-cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone) to resolve complex supplier and in-line failures.

- Execute Nonconforming Material (MRB) Process: Execute the nonconforming material (MRB) process, dispositioning defective parts and collaborating with supply chain on vendor corrective action requests (5-Why/8D SCARs).

- Author Technical Inspection Documentation: Author, review, and update technical inspection guides, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and quality control plans.

What You Bring:

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- 6+ years of experience in quality engineering, quality assurance, or manufacturing operations.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience working as a quality technician or inspection engineer.

- Ability to support Quality Leads/Managers in managing quality workflows, technician activities, and QMS initiatives.

- Working knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, or similar quality management systems (implementation and audit support experience preferred).

- Exceptional ability to read and interpret complex mechanical engineering drawings and Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T).

- Highly proficient with precision tools including calipers, micrometers, drop gauges, height gauges, dial indicators, and CMM/optical comparator tools.

- Deep expertise in Lean Manufacturing principles, 5S, root-cause methodologies, and continuous improvement tools.

- Familiarity with Cal/OSHA health and safety regulations within manufacturing settings.

- Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets), Microsoft Office, ERP/QMS platforms, and technical documentation tools.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green Belt or Black Belt) and/or ASQ Certification (CQE, CQA, CQM).

- Experience establishing or scaling quality functions within high-growth hardware or startup environments.

- High desire and aptitude to support Quality Leads/Managers while coaching and growing junior technicians.

- Success in executing root-cause countermeasures that yield measurable quality and yield improvements.

- Write high-quality, maintainable, observable, and well-documented production code

- Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality and standards

- Use AI tooling throughout the development lifecycle and holding AI-assisted work to the same bar as anything you'd write by hand

- Learn and grow as a developer while making a positive impact on our products and customers; bringing the team along with you as your expertise grows

- Own the operation of these APIs and services by embracing Site Reliability Engineering culture, measuring performance, load testing, creating and fine-tuning alerts, dashboards, runbooks, and responding to incidents

- Participate in rapid response on-call rotation in support of the team’s external and internal services

- 6+ years of experience in software development within a production environment working preferably with Python, Java and/or Go

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Geosciences, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

- Solid understanding of software engineering best practices and development methodologies

- Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills - written and verbal; you are comfortable writing an engineering design proposal and soliciting feedback to drive collaborative decisions

- Familiarity with GCP or AWS

- Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently, navigate uncertain and sometimes ambiguous problem spaces, and take calculated risks

- Experience working with diverse data storage systems such as relational databases, document stores, and key-value stores

- Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills

- Experience with Git, large codebases, reviewing merge requests, and running complex CI/CD pipelines

- Comfortable working with Docker containers

- Solid intuition of when AI is useful in software development and when it is not

- Experience deploying to Kubernetes

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Familiarity with geospatial concepts and standards; you’ve worked with GeoTIFFs, GeoJSON, and STAC

- Familiarity with remotely sensed products and associated metadata; you know why someone wants an ortho-rectified product

- Worked with observability platforms such as Grafana

The Mission Optimization team is responsible for continuously improving the operations and productivity of the world’s largest Earth observation satellite constellation. We identify, triage, and resolve the bottlenecks that limit what our fleets can deliver – from contact scheduling and downlink latency, to collection capacity, to concepts of operation for our future missions.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team you will own optimization initiatives end to end: framing an ambiguous operational problem with data, designing the solution, and driving it into production. You'll work closely with spacecraft and systems engineering groups to understand what our current and future fleets are actually capable of, with the software and operations teams who build and run the systems you're changing, and with Product to stay anchored to customer commitments and SLA risk. Being as effective at building agreement across those boundaries as you are at writing the code is a core part of this job.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Own significant optimization initiatives end to end – problem definition, data analysis, solution design, implementation, and measurement of the outcome against fleet SLAs and KPIs

- Design, develop, and maintain mission-critical software that schedules and optimizes activities across our satellite constellations

- Define concepts of operations for current fleets and for new missions and customer use cases, working directly with spacecraft, imaging, and systems engineering teams

- Analyze operational data across the full stack to surface inefficiencies previously missed, and make the case for addressing them

- Act as a technical advisor within the team and mentor earlier-career engineers

- Represent the team's technical position with stakeholders across engineering, operations, and product

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent depth achieved through your work

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

- Deep proficiency in Python or a comparable language, with a track record of designing and shipping systems that other people depend on

- Ability to take an ambiguous, loosely scoped problem and drive it to a measurable outcome with minimal direction

- Data-driven approach, including statistical analysis and reasoning over large operational datasets

- Effective written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers

- Familiarity with satellite engineering, orbital mechanics, or the space environment and its operational constraints

- Hands-on experience operating spacecraft or other remote/autonomous systems

- Experience defining concepts of operations for complex systems

- Background in optimization, scheduling, or operations research — constraint solvers, heuristics, combinatorial optimization

- Experience with DevOps tooling and practices (Git, GitLab, Docker, CI/CD, Linux, Sentry, Datadog)

The Storage team at Planet builds and expands the core object and metadata storage platform that underpins the company's data infrastructure. The ideal candidate acts as an advisor to others, brings specialized depth of expertise, applies broad knowledge of engineering principles, and strengthens the team through technical analysis and collaboration.

- Operate and tune Elasticsearch indexing for core data sets

- Fluency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) as part of your daily engineering workflow

- Ability to advise team members on complex technical matters and adapt communication styles for key contacts

- Ability to analyze complex issues and provide in-depth technical evaluation for distributed backend services

postings.title: Senior Solutions Architect I, Pre-Sales - AUS
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As a Senior Solutions Architect I on our Pre-Sales team, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge satellite imagery technology and mission-critical decision-making for the Australia and New Zealand Defence and Intelligence community. In this role, you will design and architect complex geospatial solutions that demonstrate the transformative value of Planet's high-frequency earth observation data to help defense and intelligence organizations overcome their most pressing challenges. You will collaborate closely with internal cross-functional partners in Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development to serve as the technical voice of the customer and directly shape Planet's industry-leading defense offerings. By bridging technical capabilities and strategic customer needs, your work directly supports Planet's mission to map the world daily and make global change visible, accessible, and actionable. The ideal candidate is an innovative technical consultant who thrives in a dynamic environment, passionate about satellite remote sensing, and dedicated to delivering impactful geospatial capabilities.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Australia. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week. This role requires travel up to 50%.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Architect and deliver solution demonstrations and presentations and highlighting technical capabilities and value of Planet’s offerings and our ability to fulfill customer’s business needs.

- Build relationships with customers’ technical and management staff as a trusted advisor to their business.

- Act as a senior technical advisor to the customer to recommend a solutions architecture that fits their business challenges.

- Craft the technical response to tenders, RFI’s/RFP’s, and unsolicited proposals with respect to Planet’s products and solutions.

- Partner with your sales team colleagues to architect and drive the technical strategy across customer and prospect account plans, shaping how accounts are engaged and won.

- Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development to act as the voice of the customer, assist with RFP and RFI preparation and submissions.

- Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.

- Represent the needs of Planet's Defence and Intelligence customers to Sales leadership by communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, CRM data, and customer feedback.

- Ability to present to key executive Government stakeholders within the Australia and New Zealand Governments

- Act as a mentor to team members and lead training to drive their development

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of experience in supporting the Australia and/or New Zealand Defence and Intelligence community in a technical capacity.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

- Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 50%.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

- Experience working with GIS and Remote Sensing users within the defence industry.

- Experience in IMINT, ISR, and related fields.

- Experience with QGIS, SocetGXP, ArcGIS, GDAL, Python, other common geospatial software packages and programming languages, and emerging technologies such as AI/ML.

- Experience designing and presenting complex systems and solutions that bridge the gap between business problems and technology to meet organizational goals, budget, and scalability needs.

- Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive working style.

- Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.

- Ability to process imagery, manipulate geospatial data, interact with APIs, and build data pipelines.

- Ability to lead technical customer engagements.

- Ability to run workshops or training sessions with users.

- Obtaining and maintaining eligibility for an Australian security clearance is required.

This role offers a unique opportunity for an engineer to take ownership of environmental testing activities supporting spacecraft production and delivery.

As a Senior Spacecraft Qualification Engineer, you will serve as the primary mechanical and environmental test engineering authority at our Berlin manufacturing site. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys hands-on work and thrives in ambiguity, with deep technical expertise, quick engineering judgment, and the ability to independently assess and resolve complex test situations while ensuring the safety of personnel and flight hardware. Coming from a dynamic aerospace environment, having completed challenging environmental test campaigns while collaborating effectively with R&D, systems, and manufacturing teams will be a solid advantage.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in our Berlin office 5 days per week. Occasional travel should be expected as part of testing and integration operations.

Impact You’ll Own:

Own environmental test execution and respond to off-nominal events:

- Review environmental test requirements, procedures, and readiness packages for spacecraft acceptance and protoflight campaigns.

- Serve as the primary technical authority during test operations including vibration, shock, thermal cycling, and thermal vacuum test operations.

- Perform hands-on operations including instrumentation setup, inspections, test monitoring, and hardware troubleshooting.

- Assess test data in real time to identify failures, anomalies, or unexpected hardware responses.

- Develop and implement technically sound recovery plans while preserving personnel safety, facility safety, and hardware integrity.

Ensure test readiness and facility capability:

- Validate test configurations, instrumentation plans, facility readiness, and hardware constraints prior to test execution.

- Coordinate with technicians and cross-functional teams to ensure safe and efficient execution of environmental test campaigns.

- Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

- Supervise and assist with procurement, machining, assembly and proofloading operations of test fixtures and Ground Support Equipment (GSE).

Drive measurement and test data analysis:

- Configure and validate data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and test monitoring tools.

- Analyze environmental test data to evaluate hardware performance, determine compliance, identify anomalies, and recommend next steps.

Implement continuous improvement and process development:

- Improve environmental test processes, procedures, facility capabilities, and operational efficiency and reliability.

- Develop practical solutions to recurring technical challenges and contribute to long-term reliability of environmental test operations.

Document and develop communication:

- Generate clear test reports, anomaly investigations, and engineering recommendations based on environmental test results.

- Provide technical guidance to technicians and advise spacecraft, systems, manufacturing, and quality teams on environmental test matters.

- Develop close communication and working relationships with Engineering and Manufacturing teams. Participate in technical reviews, program status meetings, etc.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of relevant work experience.

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Thermal Engineering or Electro-Mechanics/Robotics Engineering.

- Experience owning vibration, shock, thermal cycling, and thermal vacuum test campaigns for flight or flight-like hardware.

- Understanding of environmental verification methodologies, acceptance and protoflight testing industry standards, and flight hardware handling.

- Knowledge of spacecraft systems and the interactions between structures, mechanisms, avionics, payloads, and thermal systems.

- Knowledge of structural dynamics and vibration theory (resonance and modal behavior, wave propagation, random vibration, boundary control, etc.).

- Knowledge of heat transfer principles and thermal management technology.

- Ability to evaluate test data, identify anomalies, assess risk, make sound engineering decisions during off-nominal situations, and develop recovery plans for flight hardware.

- Proficiency in using Solidworks CAD & FEA (simulation) or equivalent.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing competing priorities and tight schedules.

- Ability to lead a team of technicians and work closely with international engineers in a collaborative environment.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Hands-on experience (portfolio submission encouraged).

- Experience in operating a variety of test machines as vibration shakers, thermal chambers, TVAC chambers, shock machine, as well as working with test equipment such as power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes.

- Experience building and working with DAQs for test article command/control and data gathering; well-versed with the instrumentation, usage, and data consumption from accelerometers, load cells and other DAQ sensors.

- Interest in prototyping, rapid iteration and agile processes. Experience in working in a machine shop.

- Interest in automation. Familiarity with Raspberry Pis, Node Red, or Python.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Planet, you will drive Planet’s largest, complex efforts that cross many teams and organizational boundaries. You will act as an accelerant, focusing on illuminating the path for teams and owning the predictability of execution through the product lifecycle. You will work closely with team leads to develop and manage end to end program plans. This includes establishing and managing internal processes, schedules, metrics, risks, and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders.

This role is focused on Planet’s Insights Platform development. This includes leading the technical programs that power how customers find, process, and stream our data. This is a full-time, remote position requiring candidates to work within the Eastern Time (ET) zone.

- Work with functions such as Product Managers, Tech Leads, Engineering Managers, Design, Data Science, and other Technical Program Managers.

- Work closely with engineering to ensure product and design requirements are implemented to scope.

- Create and manage program schedules and break those into incremental, visible milestones with definitions of done.

- Manage relationship, scope and approve work for external contract integration software developers.

- Continuously identify dependencies and risks, and work with stakeholders to make them actionable while still small.

- Facilitate decision making and healthy escalation through data-driven analysis and constructive debate.

- Communicate vertically & horizontally across business and technical teams to keep stakeholders informed of progress, priorities, risks, and changes to requirements or plans.

- Drive for results by continuously improving ways of working and processes, now and for the future.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of software development or program management experience in the areas of SaaS, complex data lifecycles, discovery/search engines, or cloud-based content delivery.

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

- Experience leading cross-functional projects across a broad organization.

- Experience with the product lifecycle: concept through development, launch preparation, go-to-market, deprecations, and end-of-life.

- Experience optimizing cross-team delivery cycles and establishing predictable execution patterns within a matrixed engineering organization.

- Experience coordinating high-stakes technical programs across global timezones, with a focus on building asynchronous workflows and healthy decision-making cultures.

- Track record of managing system migrations or service consolidations, specifically moving from fragmented legacy tools to unified platform endpoints.

- Analytical, problem-solving, and creative thinking skills paired with the ability to communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to balance the tactical day-to-day with forward-looking improvements to scale operational efficiencies.

- Actively explores AI technologies to automate workflows, improve data, or enhance team productivity.

- Experience with remote sensing, earth observation data, or geospatial systems.

- Experience working with remote, worldwide teams.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Build, deploy and maintain performant, distributed large-scale services and highly-available APIs in Go, Java and/or Python with a strong emphasis on customer experience

- Write high-quality, maintainable, observable, and well-documented production code

- Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality and standards

- Use AI tooling throughout the development lifecycle and holding AI-assisted work to the same bar as anything you'd write by hand

- Learn and grow as a developer while making a positive impact on our products and customers; bringing the team along with you as your expertise grows

- Own the operation of these APIs and services by embracing Site Reliability Engineering culture, measuring performance, load testing, creating and fine-tuning alerts, dashboards, runbooks, and responding to incidents

- Participate in rapid response on-call rotation in support of the team’s external and internal services

What You Bring:

- 4+ years of experience in software development within a production environment working preferably with Python, Java and/or Go

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Geosciences, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

- Solid understanding of software engineering best practices and development methodologies

- Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills - written and verbal; you are comfortable writing an engineering design proposal and soliciting feedback to drive collaborative decisions

- Familiarity with GCP or AWS

- Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently, navigate uncertain and sometimes ambiguous problem spaces, and take calculated risks

- Experience working with diverse data storage systems such as relational databases, document stores, and key-value stores

- Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills

- Experience with Git, large codebases, reviewing merge requests, and running complex CI/CD pipelines

- Comfortable working with Docker containers

- Solid intuition of when AI is useful in software development and when it is not

- Experience deploying to Kubernetes

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Familiarity with geospatial concepts and standards; you’ve worked with GeoTIFFs, GeoJSON, and STAC

- Familiarity with remotely sensed products and associated metadata; you know why someone wants an ortho-rectified product

- Worked with observability platforms such as Grafana

postings.title: Software Engineer, Platform Operations
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

A Software Engineer in Platform Operations is responsible for helping design, build, and operate the core infrastructure that enables Planet's engineering teams to reliably deploy and scale their services with minimal friction. This role is a key contributor to the evolution of our modern cloud-native platform, focusing on security, scalability, and reliability. This position will work as part of a team that partners with software engineers across the organization to refine and improve the deployment and operational experience. The ideal candidate is excited by the opportunity to enable software engineering at scale and provide internal users a “batteries included” infrastructure experience through our internal developer platform.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Design and implement core Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions to ensure the secure and scalable operation of Planet's services.

- Actively work on major platform modernization initiatives, including the full migration from legacy tooling to new solutions.

- Manage cloud-based infrastructure services, notably our fleet of Kubernetes clusters, and associated tooling to meet internal needs and support customer-facing service level agreements.

- Enhance and maintain observability for key platform services, leveraging Grafana and other tools to establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and improve operational readiness.

- Implement improvements and features for core systems owned by the team, such as GKE clusters, public API gateway, and other managed infrastructure solutions.

- Collaborate with software engineering teams to refine the developer experience (DevEx) of our managed infrastructure.

What You Bring:

- 4+ years of experience in a Platform Engineering, System Administration, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role.

- Deep understanding of Kubernetes, underlying compute systems, and Linux

- Working knowledge of public clouds, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS).

- Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, ArgoCD), Configuration Management (e.g. Terraform, Crossplane) and GitOps principles.

- Ability to use an operational mindset and troubleshooting prowess for complex production environments.

- Experience building services in languages such as Go and Python using tools like Git, Docker, and CI/CD workflows.

- Experience building services that leverage cloud-based infrastructure and tooling such as AWS or GCP.

- Ability to collaborate and clearly communicate designs and decisions verbally and in writing.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience in the operational management and development of core platform systems or open-source infrastructure projects.

- Experience with maintaining highly available or operationally resilient infrastructure at very large scales or across multiple clouds.

- Practical experience with networking and network architectures as it relates to platform infrastructure.

- Experience with Observability tools and best practices.

postings.description:

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Planet is developing the next generation of small satellite buses, featuring high-resolution optical imaging payloads, a space-based data center connected by optical inter-satellite links (OISLs), and high-speed RF/Microwave communication links. We continuously iterate on and develop small spacecraft communication systems—including board-level hardware, antennas, and ground station equipment—to achieve record data rates and link performance. Our system utilizes proprietary and industry-standard modems, transceivers across several bands, optical laser communication systems, and a worldwide network of ground stations.

We are seeking an experienced Satcom Modem Engineer to develop and mature our next-generation onboard satcom links, ground radios, and antenna systems, pushing the frontiers of satellite communications. You will architect, design, simulate, implement, and validate cutting-edge software-defined Satcom radios. Responsibilities include characterizing the SDR link performance of Planet’s next-generation S through Ka-band and optical terminals, selecting vendors, and managing subcontractors for Satcom solutions. You will facilitate and conduct rigorous testing on space and ground communication subsystems to ensure flight readiness. Success requires close collaboration with RF, EE, Flight SW, systems engineering, missions, and manufacturing teams.

The ideal candidate thrives in an agile, fast-paced environment and is comfortable with ambiguity.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Develop GnuRadio-based ground modem solutions.

- Architect, design, and verify space segment software-defined radios and modems.

- Lead on-orbit performance validation for end-to-end satellite communications systems.

- Lead RF/MW/Optical Communications system integration and testing.

What You Bring:

- Strong experience with DSP algorithms, digital communication theory, and implementation (including digital modulation, synchronization, error correction, floating-point, and fixed-point design).

- Experience with Software Defined Radios (SDR), specifically GNU Radio and Linux development tools.

- Experience defining and measuring radio performance metrics in real time (e.g., SNR, BER, PER, and constellation visualization).

- Experience with state-of-the-art RF System-on-Chip (SoC) implementations.

- BS in Electrical/Computer Science or equivalent experience with a focus on digital communicatons.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- MS or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a focus on digital communications.

- Expertise in Matlab and Simulink for modem design.

- Experience with SDR platforms and associated signal processing libraries (e.g., GNURadio).

- Proficiency in Linux, Python, and data analysis tools.

- Experience with optical communications and links for space applications.

- Expertise in Radar and/or Phased Array technology.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Trade Compliance to embed directly within our product and software development and data analytics teams. Your mission is to drive compliance to enable product and software delivery in a rapid development environment. You will take complex regulatory requirements and turn them into pragmatic, scalable product features and workflows.

Because our cutting-edge products serve a diverse client base ranging from commercial and Civil Government customers to the military and intelligence community, you will navigate the complex intersection of ITAR/EAR and OFAC/sanctions requirements as well as globally applicable equivalents. You will ensure trade compliance requirements are built into our product and software development architecture and deployment workflows to support product team innovation.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Washington, DC or Denver, CO office 3 days per week.

- Drive and enable trade compliance as a scalable, structured framework rather than ad-hoc requirements, enabling compliance to be built seamlessly into a rapid development environment.

- Collaborate with product managers and engineers to understand product roadmaps and product lifecycle, and drive trade compliance requirements.

- Apply a pragmatic, risk-based approach to compliance. Evaluate technical trade-offs and guide technical teams on how to meet ITAR/EAR without sacrificing speed-to-market.

- Conduct and document systematic Export Classification Orders of Review (e.g., ITAR and EAR) for complex data analytics and software solutions.

- Establish and maintain rigorous contemporaneous documentation tracking design intent/decisions and their impact on the export controls associated with the product/solution.

- To ensure ITAR/EAR compliance, design, implement, and audit technical processes to govern software development work amongst US and non-US based software teams based upon product/software classification.

- Work with product teams to develop Know Your Customer (KYC) and restricted party screening processes and workflows to tie into Planet’s restricted party screening solution and ensure compliance with OFAC/sanctions requirements (and applicable global equivalents).

- Practical knowledge of ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) and EAR (Export Administration Regulations), specifically as they apply to software, dual-use items, encryption, and satellite/geospatial data analytics.

- Experience with the product life cycle: concept through development, launch preparation, go-to-market, deprecations, and end-of-life.

- Analytical, problem-solving, and creative thinking skills paired with the ability to communicate findings and recommendations.

- Equally comfortable explaining your analyses and recommendations to business leaders as you are discussing technical trade-offs with engineers.

- Ability to balance the tactical day-to-day with forward-looking improvements to scale operational efficiencies.

- Experience working inside dynamic software engineering environments: CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and Agile methodologies.

postings.offices: San Francisco Office; Washington D.C. Office
postings.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As the Vice President of Defense and Intelligence (D&I) Engineering, you will lead, scale, and direct the software engineering organization responsible for building Planet’s end-to-end dual-use products and applications. You will own the technical architecture, systems development, and operational delivery of flagship dual-use products—such as Global Monitoring Service (GMS), Marine Domain Awareness (MDA), automated change detection feeds, and agentic workflows.

In this executive engineering role, you will lead multi-disciplinary teams across software, architecture, AI/ML, analytics, and forward deployed engineering. You will partner directly with Product Management, Core Platform Engineering, and Executive Leadership to transform raw satellite imagery and API services into scalable, mission-critical dual-use software solutions. You will oversee system availability, performance SLAs, and ITAR-compliant deployment pipelines, serving as the senior engineering authority for Planet’s defense and intelligence software portfolio. Ideal candidates are visionary engineering leaders passionate about delivering impactful geospatial solutions.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco or Washington DC office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

- Engineering Leadership & Delivery: Lead, mentor, and scale multi-disciplinary software engineering teams (software, data/ML, platform, and infrastructure) tasked with building and maintaining end-to-end dual-use products like Global Monitoring Service (GMS) and Marine Domain Awareness (MDA).

- Architecture & Systems Design: Define the software architecture, data models, and technical standards required to deliver high-throughput geospatial analytics, real-time alerting, and automated detection platforms at scale.

- Trade & Regulatory Compliance: Oversee engineering development standards and deployment pipelines to ensure full technical compliance with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

- Product Co-Development: Partner with Product Management to translate high-level market vision and defense mission requirements into scalable engineering roadmaps, system designs, and execution sprints.

- AI & Agent Integration: Direct the technical integration of advanced machine learning models, analytics, and agentic workflows into Planet's dual use product stack.

- Operational Excellence: Drive software engineering metrics, system reliability, low-latency processing, and secure cloud deployment architectures across commercial and sovereign environments.

What You Bring:

- 15+ years of experience in software engineering and systems architecture, with a focus on high-scale data, computer vision, or geospatial applications.

- 8+ years of direct experience leading and scaling multi-disciplinary engineering organizations (software, data/ML, platform, and cloud infrastructure).

- Direct experience managing engineering teams, software build pipelines, and data handling governed by International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

- Track record of architecting, building, and operating end-to-end dual-use or defense software applications (such as domain awareness, automated change detection, or spatial monitoring platforms) at scale.

- Active high-level government security clearance, or eligibility to obtain top-secret clearance upon hire.

- Deep technical expertise in distributed cloud architectures, high-throughput data processing pipelines, API infrastructure, and machine learning model integration.

- Ability to drive software delivery metrics, maintain high operational availability/SLAs, and establish rigorous engineering practices.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a relevant technical discipline.

- Direct engineering experience building foundation models for remote sensing use cases, agentic platforms, or automated tip-and-cue execution loops.

- Background in developing software for secure government environments, air-gapped systems, or sovereign cloud deployments (e.g., AWS GovCloud/C2S).

- Experience in multi-sensor data fusion workflows, including optical satellite imagery and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR).

- Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional creative teams

- Experience with visual storytelling principles, sound design, pacing, and emotional resonance

We are seeking a versatile Werkscontroller (m/w/d) / Controller Manufacturing to serve as a key bridge between our newly established Berlin manufacturing facility and our US financial operations. In this dual-impact role, you will lead the cost accounting workflows and local compliance for our German entity (GmbH) while simultaneously supporting global cost accounting tasks, cross-border subsidiary reconciliations, and capital expenditure tracking. You will partner with operational leaders to establish scalable standard costing methodologies, maintain inventory integrity across multiple locations, and ensure seamless financial alignment between EMEA and US teams. Ideal candidates are detail-oriented professionals with background in multi-entity global structures who thrive in cross-functional environments.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

- Partner with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.

- Lead monthly close processes for GmbH inventory, including raw materials, WIP, and finished goods reconciliations, while overseeing physical cycle counts and analyzing adjustments.

- Ensure local accounting activities comply with German GAAP (HGB), prepare cost breakdowns for German R&D tax incentives (e.g., Forschungszulage), and manage financial documentation for local government grants and subsidies.

- Manage PCard reconciliations for lab equipment and flight materials while reviewing capital expenditure vs. operational expenses (CIP/Expense classifications) for the German entity.

- Serve as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off, high-volume periods, and initial US-hours coverage through cross-training on US month-end workflows.

- Review and clear consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.

- Maintain costs associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes while tracking movements across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.

- Assist in labor capitalization tracking across internal software development, satellite construction, and commissioning efforts.

- Perform purchase price variance (PPV), production variance, scrap, and Excess & Obsolete (E&O) analysis while preparing balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and accrued purchases/prepaid manufacturing schedules for US and EMEA operations.

- Support internal and external audits across US GAAP, local German GAAP, and SOX controls.

What You Bring:

- 4+ years of relevant cost accounting experience in a manufacturing or high-tech operational environment.

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German Ausbildung, e.g., Industriekaufmann/-frau, with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).

- Experience with inventory controls and multi-entity global structures.

- Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Professional working proficiency in German and English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB).

- Hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP.
